description: Rebuild the Lesson Interface (LecturePlayerPage.tsx) and Learning Path (MatrixPage.tsx) to premium visual quality. The lecture player should feel like a Netflix/Coursera-grade viewing experience. The learning path matrix should feel like an interactive knowledge map with visual richness.
steps: Step 1: Rebuild LecturePlayerPage.tsx layout - Change the video + sidebar layout to a more immersive design: video takes full width at top with a gradient overlay at bottom showing title/progress. The chapters sidebar becomes a collapsible panel that slides in from the side (on desktop) or bottom sheet (on mobile). Add a floating mini-player progress bar at the bottom that shows lecture completion.

Step 2: Enhance the checkpoint overlay - Make it feel like a premium quiz modal: glass-morphism background with blur, animated entrance (scale + fade), options as large touch-friendly cards with hover states (gradient border reveal), correct/incorrect feedback with animated checkmark/X icon and color pulse.

Step 3: Add lecture meta section enhancements - Below the video, add a premium info bar showing: instructor avatar + name, lecture number badge, duration, checkpoint count. Style as a horizontal pill bar with glass background. Add 'bookmarks' and 'notes' mock icon buttons.

Step 4: Rebuild MatrixPage.tsx - Transform the knowledge matrix from a simple grid into a visually rich 'constellation map' feel. Each course section becomes a premium expandable card with: gradient header matching course theme color, a mini progress ring, concept count badge. The concept cells become interactive tiles with animated fill based on mastery level.

Step 5: Enhance matrix cells - Each cell gets: colored border-left based on level (green/blue/amber/red), an animated progress fill as background (width = mastery %), hover state reveals a tooltip-style popover with details, smooth color transitions between states. Use CSS custom properties for per-cell colors.

Step 6: Rebuild the gaps section at top of MatrixPage - Make each gap item a premium card with: warning-toned gradient background, animated alert icon, clear CTA button with hover arrow animation. Add a progress ring showing how close to threshold the concept is.

Step 7: Create frontend/src/styles/redesign-lecture.css - Contains: immersive video wrapper styles, floating progress bar, glass checkpoint overlay with animations, chapter panel slide-in transitions, premium meta bar. All with mobile considerations.

Step 8: Create frontend/src/styles/redesign-matrix.css - Contains: constellation-style matrix grid, animated cell fills, expandable course cards with gradient headers, gap cards with warning treatment, smooth scroll and reveal animations for the grid.

Step 9: Mobile adaptations - Video goes full-width edge-to-edge on phone. Chapters become a bottom sheet (fixed bottom, slides up). Matrix cells reduce to 2-col on tablet, 1-col on phone. Gap cards stack cleanly. All touch targets 44px+.
Step 10: Add prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks for all new animations in both new CSS files.
acceptance_criteria: LecturePlayerPage.tsx and MatrixPage.tsx compile without TypeScript errors
Lecture player has immersive full-width video with gradient overlay
Checkpoint overlay uses glassmorphism with animated entrance
Matrix cells show colored progress fill based on mastery level
Gap items have premium warning-toned card treatment
Course sections in matrix have gradient header matching theme color
Mobile layout handles video, chapters, and matrix grid cleanly
All new animations have prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks
No horizontal overflow on any screen size
